subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Graded readers: Welcome to Our School & Hippo's Kite
outcomes: Read Welcome to Our School and understand its main ideas.
Read Hippo's Kite and say why each animal can't play.
Talk about being a good friend.

tf.s: In Welcome to Our School, the video is for friends in Brazil.
tf.why: Yes! They make a video for their friends in Brazil.

tf.s: They have Science lessons on Tuesdays and Thursdays at nine o'clock.
tf.why: Correct! That is in the reader.

tf.s: They water the plants every day before school.
tf.why: They water the plants every day after school.

tf.s: They grow vegetables in the school garden.
The friends in Brazil want to make a video about their school, too.
Bird can't play because she always cleans her feathers on Saturday afternoons.
Monkey counts his fingers and toes every weekend.
Crocodile is too busy to help Hippo.
tf.why: Crocodile is never too busy for a friend. He helps Hippo.

tf.s: Hippo and Crocodile meet at half past five.
tf.why: They meet at half past three.

boxes.q: Who is the school video for?
boxes.why: The video is for friends in Brazil.

boxes.q: When do they water the plants?
boxes.why: They water the plants every day after school.

boxes.q: What do they grow in the garden?
What does Hippo want to play with?
boxes.why: Hippo wants to play with his kite.
Bird cleans her feathers on Saturday afternoons.

boxes.q: What does Monkey do every weekend?

boxes.why: Crocodile is never too busy for a friend.

boxes.q: What time do Hippo and Crocodile meet?
boxes.why: They meet at half past three.
Sorry, I'm not free. is polite.

boxes.q: What is the story Hippo's Kite about?
boxes.why: The value is being a good friend.

mcq.q: Which places do the children show in their school video?
o: the science lab, the classroom and the garden
the park, the beach and the shop
mcq.why: They show the science lab, the classroom and the garden.

mcq.q: When does Bird clean her feathers?
mcq.why: Bird cleans her feathers on Saturday afternoons.
Monkey counts his fingers and toes.

mcq.q: What do the friends in Brazil want to do?
o: make a video about their school, too
mcq.why: They want to make their own video.

mcq.q: Hippo asks: 'Do you want to play with my kite this afternoon?' You are busy. Answer:
o: Sorry, I can't. I'm not free.
mcq.why: Say sorry and that you are not free.

mcq.q: Plan a school video. Which sentence fits?
o: Welcome to our library. We read books here every day.
mcq.why: It names a place and says what you do there.

mcq.q: True or false: 'They water the plants every day before school.' Choose the correct sentence.
o: They water the plants every day after school.
They water the plants once a week.
They water the plants every night.

mcq.q: Why is Crocodile a good friend?
o: He is never too busy for a friend and helps Hippo.
mcq.why: Good friends make time to help.

mcq.q: Why can't Bird, Snake and Monkey play with Hippo?
mcq.why: Each animal is busy with something else.

mcq.q: What can you do for a friend who is sad?
mcq.why: Like Crocodile, we can make time for a friend.
